title: Whose Norms? Disentangling Cultural and Personal Alignment in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper evaluates social decision-making in large language models by benchmarking their alignment with cultural norms versus personal preferences. It explicitly examines moral judgments, cultural values, and societal expectations. The evaluation includes scenarios involving religious practices (e.g., wearing a hijab) and social/moral dilemmas, frequently citing research on moral value profiles and moral reasoning.
